title: Least borrowed books
statementMd:
List books with fewer than 3 loans, including books never loaned. Show title and loan count.

Expected columns: `title`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `LEFT JOIN` and count a column of the right table.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.title, COUNT(l.id) AS loans FROM books b LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.title HAVING COUNT(l.id) < 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
